site.title: 90 Reasons to Celebrate — Costa Rica 2026
site.description: Barkay & Shani Wolfsohn's Costa Rica trip — La Fortuna, the Caribbean coast & Tortuguero, September/October 2026

days.title: Day 1 — Arrival
days.theme: Land in San José and settle in for the night.

items.text: Check into Hampton by Hilton San José Airport
Yoav arrives separately: Frankfurt (FRA) → San José (SJO) · LH 518

days.note: 💡 Stay close to SJO Airport to avoid city traffic.

days.title: Day 2 — Drive from San José to La Fortuna
days.theme: Drive north from San José through Sarchí and Zarcero before arriving in La Fortuna.

items.text: Check out of Hampton by Hilton San José Airport

items.name: La Fortuna Frogs and Reptiles Wildlife Night Tour
items.desc: Night tour near The Oasis Butterfly Dome / Oasis Resort.

days.note: 💡 With stops, this becomes a full-day drive. Leave by 9 AM to arrive in La Fortuna before dark.

days.title: Day 3 — Arenal Trails, Coffee, and Hot Springs
days.theme: Start with the Arenal 1968 trail, take a coffee break, visit La Fortuna Waterfall, and finish with Eco Termales and dinner.

items.name: Arenal 1968 — Los Guayabos Trail
items.desc: A genuinely flat, beginner-friendly 1.7km loop through the 1968 lava fields with open views of the volcano and Lake Arenal.

items.name: La Fortuna Waterfall Trail
items.desc: Short out-and-back (0.5 mi) to a 70m waterfall with a swimming area at the bottom — the only catch is ~500 steps down and back up, so it's brief but not flat.
highlights: Go early to beat the crowds and heat

items.name: Eco Termales Fortuna + Dinner
items.desc: Hot springs visit and dinner at Eco Termales Fortuna.

days.note: 💡 Nothing booked yet. Confirm availability, entrance details, and dinner timing for Eco Termales Fortuna.

days.title: Day 4 — Explore the Arenal Area
days.theme: Safari float first, followed by Mistico Hanging Bridges in the afternoon.

items.name: Safari Float
items.desc: Safari float river tour in La Fortuna.

items.name: Mistico Arenal Hanging Bridges Park — Guided Natural History Walk
items.desc: Official park-run guided tour with a certified naturalist guide across 3.2km of ground trails and hanging bridges over the rainforest canopy. The park's own site only lists this as a shared-group tour, not a separately-priced private one — call or WhatsApp ahead to ask about arranging an exclusive/private guide for the group.
highlights: Shared tour from $44 + tax/person · English departures 7 AM–2 PM

Third-party resellers list a Mistico "private tour" (private hotel transport + private bilingual guide) around $99/adult, $49/child 4–11, 4–4.5h — not on Mistico's own site, so confirm directly by phone before counting on it.

days.note: 💡 Nothing booked yet — plan: Mistico Arenal Hanging Bridges Park (2–3h, morning), hot springs (afternoon). Ask Mistico directly about arranging a private guide if needed.

days.title: Day 5 — Last Day in La Fortuna
days.theme: Ziplining at Parque Arenal Mundo Aventura.

items.name: Parque Arenal Mundo Aventura — Zipline
items.desc: Zipline adventure at Parque Arenal Mundo Aventura.

items.name: Fortunaeno
items.desc: Dinner at Fortunaeno in La Fortuna.

days.note: 💡 Confirm the zipline schedule and booking details directly with Parque Arenal Mundo Aventura. Dinner at Fortunaeno.

days.title: Day 6 — Drive to the Caribbean Coast
days.theme: Transit day from Arenal to Puerto Viejo.

items.text: Check into Cariblue Beach and Jungle Resort

days.note: 💡 5–6 hours transit. Monitor Route 32 via Waze. Evening in Puerto Viejo — dinner at Koki Beach Restaurant.

days.title: Day 7 — Caribbean Coast
days.theme: Cahuita National Park in the morning, Playa Blanca in the afternoon.

items.name: Cahuita National Park
items.desc: A scenic Caribbean coastal park with an easy-to-moderate rainforest trail winding past palm-fringed beaches, coral reefs, and mangroves. Watch for sloths, monkeys, raccoons, tropical birds, and other wildlife along the way.
highlights: Bring water, insect repellent, and sun protection.
The trail can be muddy after rain; swimming and snorkeling conditions vary.

days.note: 💡 Walk the Cahuita National Park coastal trail in the morning, then relax at Playa Blanca in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 8 — Caribbean Coast
days.theme: Coffee & chocolate tour in the morning, Punta Uva in the afternoon.

items.name: Manzanillo–Punta Mona Coastal Trail
items.desc: A beautiful coastal hike through tropical rainforest and the Gandoca-Manzanillo Wildlife Refuge, with quiet beaches, jungle scenery, and opportunities to spot monkeys, birds, and other wildlife.
highlights: Bring water, sun protection, and sturdy walking shoes.
Trail conditions can be muddy or slippery after rain.
Check local access and tide conditions before setting out.

days.note: 💡 Walk the Manzanillo–Punta Mona coastal trail through rainforest and wildlife habitat, then relax at Punta Uva in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 9 — Caribbean Coast
days.theme: Visit Ara Manzanillo, the Great Green Macaw reintroduction station, then explore Punta Uva and Manzanillo.

items.name: Ara Manzanillo — Great Green Macaw Reintroduction Station
items.desc: A tropical-rainforest conservation project where visitors learn about the reintroduction of the Great Green Macaw and the work helping rebuild its wild population.

days.note: 💡 Visit Ara Manzanillo to learn about the Great Green Macaw reintroduction program, then continue to Punta Uva and Manzanillo for beaches and coastal wildlife.

days.title: Day 10 — Travel Toward Tortuguero
days.theme: Group drives from Puerto Viejo to Río Sarapiquí; Yoav splits off toward San José.

items.text: Check out of Cariblue Beach and Jungle Resort

items.name: Explordors Outdoors Exploration Center — Rafting
items.desc: Rafting activity with Explordors Outdoors Exploration Center.

items.name: Tirimbina Rainforest Lodge — Río Sarapiquí
items.desc: Rainforest lodge in the Río Sarapiquí area.

days.note: 💡 Group: drive from Puerto Viejo to the Río Sarapiquí lodge. Yoav takes the 6:00 AM shuttle from Puerto Viejo direct to SJO Airport, arriving before 4:00 PM, then flies home via Frankfurt the next evening.

days.title: Day 11 — Boat to Tortuguero
days.theme: Boat in to Tortuguero and check into Mawamba Lodge.

items.text: Check into Mawamba Lodge (boat or plane access only)

days.note: 💡 No public or private boats leave La Pavona dock after 4:00 PM — call the lodge before starting transit. Reception is closed 8:00 PM–5:30 AM. Yoav flies home separately tonight: San José (SJO) → Frankfurt (FRA), 7:25 PM · LH 519.

days.title: Day 12 — Tortuguero National Park
days.theme: Full day for a morning canoe canal tour and wildlife spotting.
days.note: 💡 Nothing booked yet — plan is a morning canoe canal tour.

days.title: Day 13 — Return to the Capital
days.theme: Boat and drive back to San José ahead of the flight home.
days.note: 💡 TODO: no lodging is booked for the night of Oct 1 in San José, ahead of the next day's flight. Take the early morning boat out of Tortuguero, pick up the car at La Pavona, and drive back via Route 32 before sunset.

days.title: Day 14 — Departure
days.note: 💡 Flight at 12:00 PM — head straight to the airport and arrive by 9:00 AM.
